purpose: Prove one real end-to-end UGMU purchase against the already launched live YooKassa configuration without expanding production scope.
executionPlanAfterAuthorization: Run a fresh read-only operational preflight immediately before creating any order.
Create at most one live UGMU order for ОЛД 101 using the current runtime semester offer; do not hardcode or override the production price.
Return the YooKassa confirmation URL for user-controlled payment completion; do not enter payment credentials or confirm the financial transaction on the user's behalf.
After the user completes payment, verify the provider payment is succeeded, paid=true and test=false.
Verify the protected order becomes succeeded and exactly one paid subscription is issued.
Verify the tokenized subscription calendar returns HTTP 200 and contains the expected UGMU schedule while public schedule and public ICS remain HTTP 404.
Verify no second payment/order is created and no non-UGMU sales capability changes.
Revoke the canary subscription after evidence capture unless the user explicitly asks to keep that subscription active.
Run the full read-only operational monitor again and confirm the production invariants remain unchanged.
abortConditions: public UGMU schedule or public ICS becomes available
any of the 12 schedule hashes or rollback snapshots fails verification
more than one canary order or payment is observed
